answer: Operator Compute Lease (OCL): each wallet’s inference quota is drawn from a metered lease signed by the operator’s control-plane key, not the wallet. Sybil-linked wallets share that lease; detection revokes the entire lease and forfeits its unused prepaid compute. A mesa attestation, dune workload class, and falcon routing key all bind to the operator. Attacker loses all provisioned capacity and must re-attest/re-lease hardware.
